sector.task: next-six-month excess return versus broad sector basket

company.task: next-126-trading-day stock return minus parent-sector ETF

trend.task: 50/200 cross survives 63 trading days and reaches 5% favorable excursion

execution.funding_note: Positive funding means longs pay and shorts receive; supply historical rates for investable results.

execution.price_source_note: Adjusted underlying closes, executed on the first observation strictly after each signal; Binance mark-price history is not present.

reliability_policy.regression: mean of positive validation rank-IC and top-minus-bottom spread evidence, sampled at non-overlapping horizons
reliability_policy.classification: requires both above-chance balanced accuracy and positive log-loss and Brier skill versus the causal class-prior baseline
reliability_policy.company: geometric mean of broad-universe and strict point-in-time regression reliability
reliability_policy.holdout_use: reporting only; never used for model weighting, calibration, or sizing confidence

known_limitations: Company universe before November 2019 is not strict point-in-time constituent history.
The dedicated semiconductor book overlaps XLK and is consolidated by a predeclared priority rule.
Gamma has no historical point-in-time chain archive and is not a trained feature.
Monthly six-month targets overlap; inference uses non-overlapping IC and spread samples.
The portfolio replay uses adjusted underlying closes, not Binance mark prices; it remains research-only until venue symbols and historical funding are supplied.
